install.command: bash -o pipefail -c 'curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.12.19/install.sh | sh' && "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" python install 3.11 && "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" sync --project docker/validator --group validator --locked --python 3.11 && "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" pip install --python docker/validator/.venv/bin/python pytest==9.1.1 pytest-cov==7.1.0 coverage==7.16.1
